newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Maharani Intifinance rises on debut.
newsitem.headline: Maharani Intifinance rises on debut.

text.p: Indonesian multi-finance company PT Maharani Intifinance rose by about 37.5 percent from its offer price on its debut on Wednesday.
The company's shares rose to a high of 850 rupiah against its offer price of 600 rupiah before easing back to 800 rupiah in early trade. Volume was modest at about 20.6 million shares.
"I can see the potential upside is still on but small," a broker with a European securities firm said, adding that relatively weak market sentiment had given small support to the counter.
The company's operations include consumer financing and leasing.
Another broker with a local firm believed strong support from the issuer and underwriter would help maintain the counter at a good price.
PT Maharani Intifinance offered 58.8 million shares June 30 to July 2, with PT Pentasena Arthasentosa and PT Panin Sekuritas as a lead underwriters.
The company said in its prospectus that 95 percent of the proceeds would be used to strenghten its working capital, while it would allocate the remaining five percent to expand new branches.
PT Maharani is controlled by one of President Suharto's daughters, Siti Hediati Prabowo.
